changes.description: Libraries used by the BIND DNS packages
changes.note:
Fixes multiple CVEs

- Potential wildcard CNAME RPZ policy bypass (CVE-2026-11331)
- Key Record using PRIVATEDNS algorithm may lead to exit (CVE-2026-10822)
- Record ordering based unexpected exit with CNAME or DNAME (CVE-2026-12617)
- Potential memory usage beyond configured limits (CVE-2026-11622)
- Cache poisoning via label count discrepancy, RRSIG, wildcards (CVE-2026-11721)
- Incorrect acceptance of NSEC3 records (CVE-2026-10723)
- Unexpected exit with NSEC and NSEC3 both present (CVE-2026-13204)
- DNSSEC Validation Bypass via Out-of-Zone NSEC Next Field (CVE-2026-13321)

changes.description: A library and drivers for direct userspace use of RDMA hardware
changes.note:
Update to the latest stable-v61 branch. Contains bug fixes:

 - providers/erdma: Initialize CQ doorbell record
 - providers/erdma: Allocate CQ buffer with mmap
 - ionic: Fix have_movdir64b() cpuid max-leaf query
 - mlx5: Fix clock update EBUSY error flow
 - libibverbs: Set vmr->access in ibv_cmd_reg_mr_ex()
 - libibnetdisc: keep cache loadable after port timeouts
 - libibnetdisc: guard against NULL remoteport in chassis grouping
 - librdmacm: Change wake-up timeout from rpoll
 - rxe: Fix dma.length computation in wr_set_sge_list
 - util: Fix node name map duplicate issue
 - pyverbs: Replace WeakSet.pop() with list cleanup
 - librdmacm: Fix rpoll in case of timeout
 - librdmacm: Fix rfcntl to keep fs flags separately
 - tests/test_cq: Prevent CQ overflows by introducing a delay before resize
 - tests: Fix memory leak in test_mlx5_crypto
 - providers/mana: do not check cqid on creation
 - mlx5/vfio: Avoid warning for unused count variable
 - ibstat: ignore non-RDMA endpoint devices when umad_get_ca() fails
 - librdmacm: Add rsocket to connect service on success too
 - librdmacm: Fix select function
 - librdmacm: Fix SOCK_STREAM and SOCK_DGRAM types
 - providers/rxe: Avoid 32-bit overflow when validating inline send length
 - providers/rxe: Fix missing length accumulation in wr_set_inline_data_list
 - libhns: Fix UD 0 msg length err using new post send
 - mlx5: Fix inline-scatter source address on 128B CQE REQ completions
 - bnxt_re/lib: Fix the flush CQE handling
 - bnxt_re/lib: Fix the num_attrs used in bnxt_re_get_toggle_mem uapi
 - bnxt_re/lib: Report vendor_err as zero for all flush completions.
 - bnxt_re/lib: Fix memcpy size in bnxt_re_create_qp
 - buildlib: disable symbol version check
 - bnxt_re/lib: Initialize the SRQ request structure
 - bnxt_re/lib: Initialize the request structures
 - ionic: Honor sq_sig_all for signaled completions
 - dump_fts: Change lft type in dump_fts to uint8_t
 - mlx5: Fix mlx5dv_create_flow to keep legacy ABI
 - libibverbs: Avoid memcpy from NULL in fill_attr_in()
 - debian: correct symbol version of new ibverbs 1.15 functions
 - libhns: Fix CQ clean when CQ record doorbell enabled
 - libhns: Fix wrong WQE data in new post send API when QP wraps around

changes.description: Netscape Portable Runtime
Network Security Services
changes.note:
NSS Release Notes

Update NSS to 3.127.0

- Bug 1869493 - Heap-buffer overflow in AES Keywrap.
- Bug 2052210 - Generate additional test message for Thunderbird (HTML with remote image).
- Bug 2052709 - Convert NSS 3.126 release notes to Markdown.
- Bug 2053831 - clang format.
- Bug 2054609 - remove cipher suite order exception from bug 946147.
- Bug 2054714 - avoid leaking stale ECH outer extensions across HRR.
- Bug 2054719 - fix content type tag for CMS AuthEnvelopedData plaintext.
- Bug 2056291 - remove support for pre-v1.0 PKCS#12.
- Bug 2056846 - Remove unused policy string callback to fix -Wunused-but-set-global.
- Bug 2057184 - Enable -Wunused-but-set-variable/-global in werror.py.
- Bug 2059176 - EC_DerivePublicKey() failure is not propagated in sftk_mkPrivKey().
- Bug 2060118 - remove DH_GenParam support.
- Bug 2060720 - Round ECH ClientHelloInner padding up to a multiple of 32.
- Bug 2061107 - restore pkcs12.h for source compatibility.
- Bug 2063071 - make selfserv listen on IPv6 wildcard on dual-stack hosts.

https://firefox-source-docs.mozilla.org/security/nss/releases/nss_3_127.html

- Updated Firefox to latest release (155.0)

changes.description: Common files for all subpackages of rdma-core
changes.note:
Update to the latest stable-v61 branch. Contains bug fixes:

 - providers/erdma: Initialize CQ doorbell record
 - providers/erdma: Allocate CQ buffer with mmap
 - ionic: Fix have_movdir64b() cpuid max-leaf query
 - mlx5: Fix clock update EBUSY error flow
 - libibverbs: Set vmr->access in ibv_cmd_reg_mr_ex()
 - libibnetdisc: keep cache loadable after port timeouts
 - libibnetdisc: guard against NULL remoteport in chassis grouping
 - librdmacm: Change wake-up timeout from rpoll
 - rxe: Fix dma.length computation in wr_set_sge_list
 - util: Fix node name map duplicate issue
 - pyverbs: Replace WeakSet.pop() with list cleanup
 - librdmacm: Fix rpoll in case of timeout
 - librdmacm: Fix rfcntl to keep fs flags separately
 - tests/test_cq: Prevent CQ overflows by introducing a delay before resize
 - tests: Fix memory leak in test_mlx5_crypto
 - providers/mana: do not check cqid on creation
 - mlx5/vfio: Avoid warning for unused count variable
 - ibstat: ignore non-RDMA endpoint devices when umad_get_ca() fails
 - librdmacm: Add rsocket to connect service on success too
 - librdmacm: Fix select function
 - librdmacm: Fix SOCK_STREAM and SOCK_DGRAM types
 - providers/rxe: Avoid 32-bit overflow when validating inline send length
 - providers/rxe: Fix missing length accumulation in wr_set_inline_data_list
 - libhns: Fix UD 0 msg length err using new post send
 - mlx5: Fix inline-scatter source address on 128B CQE REQ completions
 - bnxt_re/lib: Fix the flush CQE handling
 - bnxt_re/lib: Fix the num_attrs used in bnxt_re_get_toggle_mem uapi
 - bnxt_re/lib: Report vendor_err as zero for all flush completions.
 - bnxt_re/lib: Fix memcpy size in bnxt_re_create_qp
 - buildlib: disable symbol version check
 - bnxt_re/lib: Initialize the SRQ request structure
 - bnxt_re/lib: Initialize the request structures
 - ionic: Honor sq_sig_all for signaled completions
 - dump_fts: Change lft type in dump_fts to uint8_t
 - mlx5: Fix mlx5dv_create_flow to keep legacy ABI
 - libibverbs: Avoid memcpy from NULL in fill_attr_in()
 - debian: correct symbol version of new ibverbs 1.15 functions
 - libhns: Fix CQ clean when CQ record doorbell enabled
 - libhns: Fix wrong WQE data in new post send API when QP wraps around
